card.name: Words just before "history of"
card.fires_on: The word "a" or "family" right after "patients with" or in a list of risk factors, where "history of" is expected next. It fires in label risk statements.

modes.label: "a" before history
modes.description: The article "a" after "with" or a comma in a risk-factor list, just before "history of".
modes.example: in individuals with<< a>> history of sensitivity to multiple allergens.

modes.label: "family" before history
modes.description: The word "family" after "personal or", just before "history of".
modes.example: Risks are increased in patients with a personal or<< family>> history of substance abuse

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "history" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "history" in phrases like "patients with a history of".
